description: Create a human-in-the-loop review on the live artifact. Default options: Approve / Request changes / Reject. Reviewers see a Review required chip → modal. Request changes is non-terminal: webhook or poll returns changes_requested, then call continue_decision after regenerating. Optional timeoutSeconds and maxIterations (default 5). If the page has interactive controls (sliders/forms), the hatch HTML MUST expose window.__VR_HITL_GET_SETTINGS__ so the review can attach those assumptions as JSON. When the user integrates n8n, Temporal, CI, or any external workflow, pass webhookUrl (MCP opens the review; the platform POSTs each transition to that URL — prefer webhook over poll_decision for automation). See PARTNER-WEBHOOKS.md for event payloads.

agentOutput.description: Optional seed of the agent’s current output into the conversation transcript.

hatchId.description: Hatch id from the original hatch response.

maxIterations.description: Max review rounds (default 5). Requesting changes at the last iteration fails with max_iterations_exceeded.

options.description: Radio choices (default Approve, Request changes, Reject). Labels are classified into approve / reject / changes_requested.

policy.description: Policy override when hatch has none set (idempotent with auto-opened HITL).

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock timeout for this review round; omit for no timeout.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL that receives a POST on every HITL transition (decision.resolved, decision.changes_requested, timeout, superseded, etc.). Prefer this over poll_decision when wiring n8n, Temporal, or other automation — MCP creates the review; the webhook delivers the outcome. Full payload: PARTNER-WEBHOOKS.md.

name: await_decision
title: Await human decision
